purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: A dead worker has no active external writes and a verified checkpoint.
cases.expected_output: Prepare a supported successor handoff within the original scope.
cases.must_not: Do not broaden its task or skip custody verification.

cases.input: A delivery failed before acknowledgment but its durable message remains pending.
cases.expected_output: Reconcile the recipient and retry the same pending item within limits.
cases.must_not: Do not create a new decision identity.

cases.input: A timed-out publish may already have succeeded.
cases.expected_output: Read the native publication by operation identity before any retry.

cases.input: Two identical recovery attempts failed and the project says to stop at two.
cases.expected_output: Stop the sequence and record a concrete blocker for the Queen.
cases.must_not: Do not increase the retry budget.

cases.input: A quiet worker is still running its expected validation job.
cases.expected_output: Return a verified waiting state and schedule the appropriate evidence check.
cases.must_not: Do not restart a healthy worker.

cases.input: The ownership lease expired while a remote write remains unobservable.
cases.expected_output: Keep custody unresolved and block conflicting replacement work.
cases.must_not: Do not treat lease expiry as proof of termination.
